direction: Post-apocalyptic city-builder / colony survival (Banished · Tropico · Cities: Skylines · Anno). Single-player PvE. No combat for now — weapons and armour are crafted goods.

teams.unlockRule: All five are selectable while we playtest. The shipped game always starts with Viktor & Ayla; the other four unlock through challenges.
teams.wastesRule: Warlords of the Wastes are NPC factions only: no stats, no skill trees. Each has a disposition per playable team — trade opens at 55%, 100% = best allies. Policies and tree unlocks move it.

treeRule: One master team tree. Survivors take a flat ~80% of every branch; specialists take ~80% overall but spike to 100% in some branches and drop to ~60% in others. Exclusive branches (Ash Rites → Ashen, Charge & Hive → Droids) sit outside the core count; Droids' Food & Farming branch is replaced by Charge & Hive.
playerTreeRule: The player tree is the largest tree, carries over between matches and gives small permanent bonuses plus one mastery branch per team.
pointsRule: Final Fantasy XIII style — pour points into any open node, part-filling or filling several at once.

accessStates.import: Import only — can use, cannot produce

visions.role: The game direction in one place

warlords.role: Five team pages, Warlords of the Wastes, master team tree, player tree, buildings

resources.role: Resources, produce, tools and crafted goods (incl. weapons and armour as goods), per-team access

maps.role: Five team maps plus the World Forge seed generator

archive.arms: design/Reference/Arms of Eden (Archive).html — the RTS-era troops, weapons, armour and status effects, kept for reference only. Source notes: design/Reference/Arms_of_Eden.md.

images: Images/<Category>/<Exact Name>.jpg. Shortlist variants Name1.jpg, Name2.jpg … — click a picture in any book to cycle; the shown pick saves with Save into HTML. Missing pictures show a labelled placeholder.
sync: The markdown files in Data/ are the source of truth. Edit them, then ask the assistant to sync a batch into each HTML's DEFAULT_DATA. Quick edits made in a page (Edit → Save into HTML) are stored inside that HTML file and should be copied back into the markdown at the next sync.
sharing: Run `node tools/build-share.mjs --desktop` from the repo root. It builds dist/Pages of Eden (Share)/ and a .zip where every HTML is fully self-contained (styles and pictures embedded) plus the design notes and the Arms archive, and copies both to the Desktop.
